cohort: 362 cases of nonmalignant meningioma aged 0-37 years and 18,100 controls matched on year of birth
finding: Higher birth order was associated with a reduced risk of early-onset meningioma, while female sex and Black race were associated with an increased risk.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between delivery mode and early-onset meningioma risk.
birth_weight: Higher birthweight was associated with a higher risk of meningioma in the non-Latino White subgroup
